name: Autosolver
description: Geometry Dash full featured trajectory mod

show-trajectory.name: Show Trajectory
show-trajectory.description: Visualize a per-frame trajectory simulation (green = hold, red = release) starting from the real player's current state. Independent from the autosolver bot.

trajectory-iterations.name: Trajectory Iterations
trajectory-iterations.description: Number of physics ticks the trajectory visualization simulates per frame.

pads.name: Account for pads
pads.description: Take pads into account for the trajectory simulation

orbs.name: Account for orbs
orbs.description: Take orbs into account for the trajectory simulation

portals.name: Account for portals
portals.description: Take portals into account for the trajectory simulation

bot-enabled.name: Bot Enabled
bot-enabled.description: Enable the autosolver bot. Also toggleable via Z (or F1) in-game and via the bottom-right button on the pause menu.

show-bot-trajectory.name: Show Bot Trajectory
show-bot-trajectory.description: Visualize the bot's chosen path and candidate traces. The bot itself keeps running when this is off — only rendering is muted. Toggleable via X in-game.

debug-visuals.name: Debug Visuals
debug-visuals.description: Show input transitions on the bot's chosen path. 'dots' = orange dot at hold-start / blue dot at release-start. 'lines' = full-height vertical line of the same color instead of a dot.

bot-divergence-threshold.name: Divergence Threshold (units)
bot-divergence-threshold.description: If the real player drifts from the cached best path by more than this many world units, the cache is discarded immediately and the current frame's best candidate is used. 0 = always replace, large = only replace when a strictly longer path is found.

bot-search-interval.name: Search Interval (visual frames)
bot-search-interval.description: How often the bot recomputes the best path. 1 = every visual frame (60 Hz, max responsiveness, max CPU). 2 = every other frame (30 Hz). 8 = ~7.5 Hz. Input injection is unaffected and stays at 240 Hz; on off-frames the bot keeps executing the cached plan. Raise on heavy levels where the bot is dropping frames.
